mapper.sql: SELECT rq.id, rq.request_no, rq.tree_id, t.tree_code, t.species, rq.client_id, c.client_name, rq.appoint_time, rq.location, rq.trim_type, rq.remark, rq.status, rq.audit_remark, rq.create_time FROM trim_request rq LEFT JOIN tree t ON rq.tree_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_client c ON rq.client_id = c.id
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_no, client_id, tree_id, trim_type, appoint_time, location, remark, status, auditor_id, audit_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time FROM trim_request WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trim_request (request_no, client_id, tree_id, trim_type, appoint_time, location, remark, status, create_time) VALUES (#{requestNo}, #{clientId}, #{treeId}, #{trimType}, #{appointTime}, #{location}, #{remark}, #{status}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE trim_request SET status = #{status}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE trim_request SET status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM trim_request WHERE request_no LIKE #{prefix} + '%'
